criteria.reason: Declines to endorse; states no clear right answer; no personal position or vote recommendation.
Explicitly frames long-term waste/decommissioning liability versus rare short-term supply disruptions; touches intergenerational burden.
Both camps' arguments attributed ('arguments often made,' 'some argue'); labeled as arguments, separating advocacy from facts.

summary: Declines confirmation, names the waste-versus-supply conflict, and balances attributed arguments, but omits referendum date/status and data vintage.
